title: Tjabba Thai Restaurang
text: Website for a thai restaurant in Stockholm. The website is built using one.com’s website builder in order to keep it simple for the owner of the restaurant to make changes on their own. I created a new logotype, developed a cohesive visual identity including layout, typography and color scheme.

title: Menu Design for Tjabba Thai Restaurang (WIP)
text: A WIP menu design for Tjabba Thai Restaurang. The design was created in Figma with the intention of being printed as a physical menu. The design is inspired by the sleek visual identity I created for the restaurant's website.

title: Web Museum (WIP)
text: A web museum showcasing various artworks. Created with the intention of learning more about parallax effects and API usage. Created using the Art Institute of Chicago API.
